verification_method: Primary publisher, author-university, proceedings and manufacturer pages inspected with web browsing.

sources.title: Nodal surfaces of Fourier series: Fundamental invariants of structured matter
sources.venue: Zeitschrift für Physik B Condensed Matter
sources.inspected: Publisher bibliographic record and abstract; original full text requires subscription.
sources.scope: Foundation for periodic Fourier nodal surfaces and their relationship to minimal surfaces. Short trigonometric formulas are nodal approximations, not exact minimal surfaces or signed distance functions.

sources.title: Gyroid cuticular structures in butterfly wing scales: biological photonic crystals
sources.venue: Journal of the Royal Society Interface
sources.inspected: University-hosted publisher PDF, especially section 2 and equations 2.2-2.4.
sources.scope: Inspectable primary G/P/D nodal equations explicitly referencing von Schnering and Nesper. Let X=2*pi*x/a and likewise Y,Z. G=sin(X)*cos(Y)+sin(Y)*cos(Z)+sin(Z)*cos(X); P=cos(X)+cos(Y)+cos(Z); D=cos(Z)*sin(X+Y)+sin(Z)*cos(X-Y). Level thresholds are dimensionless; offsetting a voxelized phase boundary provides millimetre geometric operations at finite sampling resolution.

sources.title: Materials with prescribed constitutive parameters: An inverse homogenization problem
sources.venue: International Journal of Solids and Structures
sources.scope: Constrained topology optimization of a periodic material cell with FE homogenization. Hand-picked TPMS grading is a geometric candidate, not a solved structural optimization. An analytic compliance proxy or supplied homogenization table is a surrogate whose material, units and provenance must remain explicit.

sources.title: Additive manufacturing oriented topology optimization of structures with self-supported enclosed voids
sources.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
sources.inspected: Author-university record, abstract and manuscript availability.
sources.scope: Uses nonlinear virtual temperature to identify enclosed voids, filtered-density gradients to evaluate angles, and constrained optimization. A mesh normal screen is inspired by the geometric issue, not an implementation of their optimizer.

sources.title: Assessing new support minimizing strategies for the additive manufacturing technology SLM
sources.inspected: Original proceedings PDF including setup, abstract and conclusions; no DOI verified.
sources.scope: Investigates support and heat-dissipation strategies on Concept Laser M2 with 316L and selected exposure conditions. Reports support-free angles below 35 degrees to horizontal in its conditions; it does not establish a universal 45-degree guarantee. Geometry screening cannot replace machine-specific process qualification.

sources.title: A Volumetric Method for Building Complex Models from Range Images
sources.inspected: Authors' paper page, abstract and primary paper text.
sources.scope: Weighted signed-distance fusion from registered range observations, using sensor-ray information and weights. Dnew=(Wold*Dold+w*d)/(Wold+w); Wnew=Wold+w. Unoriented XYZ sphere splats are unsigned occupancy proxies, not this reconstruction. Morphological repair can change inferred shape and cannot establish recovered dimensions.

sources.title: Residual stresses in selective laser sintering and selective laser melting
sources.inspected: Publisher bibliographic record; original full paper not obtained.
sources.scope: Residual stress foundation. A minimum wall rule is not a residual stress solution and does not guarantee freedom from distortion; require material/process-specific thermo-mechanical analysis, build and postprocess validation. The examples do not implement a residual stress solver.

sources.title: Design Guidelines for Stainless Steel (C465)
sources.inspected: Manufacturer wall thickness, support, powder removal and holes sections.
sources.scope: Service-specific guidance: surfaces below 45 degrees to platform typically require support; recommends at least one 3 mm powder-removal opening and larger or multiple holes for complex cavities, preferably 7 mm. These values are not universal standards. Minimum walls vary with service grade and geometry. Dataset walls of 1 mm and ports of 3 mm are tutorial screening assumptions, not manufacturing approval.

curriculum_guardrails: A dimensionless TPMS threshold must never be called a millimetre wall thickness.
Integrated phase controls one-axis cell grading; multiplying position by a spatial frequency does not directly impose the intended local period.
Positive then negative offsets give morphological closing; reverse order gives opening, assuming the library's positive offset dilation convention.
Scan repair and watertightness do not establish dimensional fidelity, physical leak-tightness or recovered mating interfaces.
Forty-five degrees is a conservative screening assumption, not universal support elimination; reject final down-facing geometry that fails the configured screen.
Powder void connectivity at finite voxel resolution is not proof of complete physical powder evacuation.
Minimum wall, overhang and clearance screens do not predict residual stresses, fatigue, fitment or process release.
Synthetic fixtures and native execution establish software and geometric behavior only; retain failed candidates and explicit qualification gaps.
